articles.summary: WASHINGTON, DC, December 11, 2020 Firefly Aerospace, Inc., is pleased to announce its selection by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) for the launch of Mission Two of the Venture Class Launch Service Demonstration 2 (VCLS Demo 2) contract. Mission Two involves launch of two CubeSat constellations to a 550 km Sun-Synchronous Orbit, separated...
articles.title: Firefly Awarded NASA Venture Class Launch Services Demonstration 2 Contract
